scope: Native child processes only; Flutter test host excluded. Cold native instances, warm shared test host/cache. Service fixtures, no application savings comparison.
build: QuickJS-NG 0.18.0, GCC 13.3.0, CMake Release; Flutter 3.47.7 test host
cpuCounter: Separate lightweight native CPU counter commands; heap and RSS samples outside the quiet CPU interval
limitations: Shared Linux container, not dedicated hardware
Three synthetic catalog rows and one installed plugin; exact pinned real store background source
No reference-app/WebView or mobile/Windows/macOS measurements in this capture
Peak RSS is per-process VmHWM; adding peaks is not a simultaneous process-tree RSS sample
Native CPU includes lightweight command boundary overhead, not the heap/proc sampler
No Dart/Flutter broker memory, process-tree CPU or real network latency in native child metrics
instanceIdentity: instanceOrder preserves startup/CPU/memory array order; capture timestamp, hostPid, instanceId, pluginId and nativePid identify each observed instance
preparationEncoding: Explicit UTF-8 JSON/JS input/output; pinned sources and native build prepared with LC_ALL=C, PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0, PYTHONUTF8=0
